subject: literacy
concept: Stating a clear opinion or claim on a topic
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student picks a side in a simple, low-stakes debate (e.g. best season) and states their opinion aloud
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the sentence that states a clear opinion, among several purely factual ones
exercise.abstract: Student writes a single clear claim/opinion sentence on a given topic

misconception_flags: states a fact instead of an opinion
writes a vague claim with no clear position

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
